bio: Treat yourself to Afternoon Tea at Gorse Hill Hotel, a 'hidden gem' set in the beautiful countryside of Surrey. Built in 1912, this picturesque mansion provides a relaxed and intimate haven to take time out and enjoy an afternoon of indulgence.  Enjoy a delicate array of hand-cut finger sandwiches with a variety of fillings and a selection of speciality homemade pastries & delicacies served with a tea of your choice. If you’re celebrating a special occasion or just feeling a little decadent, why not add a glass of Prosecco?  Whilst guests will enjoy the peaceful surroundings of Gorse Hill Hotel, it is ideally situated just a few minutes away from the centre of Woking and easily accessible between the M25 and M3.
